hero.title: Make something new from what you already have
hero.lead: Tick what you have at home: bottles, jars, old clothes or cardboard. We'll match you with projects and step-by-step instructions.

filters.title: Find an idea
filters.materialsHint: Tick the materials you have at home. With nothing ticked, you see the whole catalog.
filters.materialsError: Couldn't load the list of materials.

results.title: Ideas
results.modeHint: Ideas you have everything for come first, followed by ones missing a single optional material.
results.emptyHint: Try ticking more materials, clearing the difficulty filter or changing your search.
results.errorText: Check your internet connection and try again.

idea.notFoundText: It may have been deleted, or the link has a typo.
idea.deleteText: “{title}” will be deleted together with its photo. This can't be undone.
idea.deleteError: Couldn't delete the idea. Please try again.

form.createLead: Describe the project so someone else can repeat it: what they need and which steps to follow.
form.editLead: Change the fields you need and save. You can keep the current photo.
form.langNote: The text will be saved in English. If the idea had a Ukrainian version, this text will replace it.
form.requiredNote: Fields marked with an asterisk are required.
form.title: Title
form.materialsHint: Tick 1 to 20 materials. At least one must be required.
form.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
form.photoHintEdit: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. If you don't pick a new photo, the current one stays.
form.dictError: Couldn't load materials and tools. Please reload the page.
form.errorSummaryText: Fix the fields below and submit again:

validation.titleLength: The title must be 3 to 120 characters long.
validation.timeRange: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 1440.
validation.descriptionLength: The description can be up to 1000 characters.
validation.materialsTooMany: You can choose up to 20 materials.
validation.materialsNeedRequired: Mark at least one material as required.
validation.quantityLength: Quantity for “{name}” can be up to 50 characters.
validation.toolsTooMany: You can choose up to 15 tools.
validation.stepsTooMany: You can add up to 30 steps.
validation.photoRequired: Add a photo of the project.
validation.photoType: The photo must be a JPG, PNG or WebP file.
validation.photoSize: The photo is too large: 5 MB maximum.

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many changes in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The photo is too large: 5 MB maximum.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: The photo must be a JPG, PNG or WebP file.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Idea not found. It may have been deleted already.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are filled in incorrectly.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again a bit later.

notFound.text: The link may be out of date. Start from the catalog — every idea is there.
